verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community comments noting that protected branches and code owners are GitHub features, available on paid plans for private repos. That shows branch protection exists, but nothing documents what the rules require. missing for 10: first-party docs on branch protection rules or rulesets, required pull request reviews before merge, required passing status checks, tag protection, and hands-on corroboration of enforcement.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can protect branches and tags with rules requiring reviews and passing checks before merge
